items.title: Input diagnostics HUD
items.summary: Add a `?debug=input` in-run overlay showing source, controller slot/type, axes, aim angle, shoot/dash/reload/grenade state, pointer coordinates, and trace evidence counts. This turns physical controller QA from a subjective 'feels wrong' loop into visible evidence while keeping the feature hidden from normal players.
items.recipe: Wire a debug flag in `App.jsx`, snapshot gamepad/mouse/trace state during polling/render, render a compact fixed overlay only when `?debug=input` or `localStorage.cod-debug-input=1` is active, and add focused launch coverage that the debug path does not break run start.

items.title: Pointer aim projection contract
items.summary: Extract browser pointer-to-canvas aim math into a pure helper and test every quadrant. This is the smallest reliable foundation for the requested browser pointer 360 regression without depending on a fragile full Playwright combat run.
items.recipe: Add `computePointerAimAngle()` and `angleToUnitVector()` to `src/systems/gameStep.js`, use it in `App.jsx`, and add unit tests proving north/east/south/west/quadrant vectors.

items.title: First-run control calibration card
items.summary: Teach players to verify full-circle aim before the first serious run, with a hidden diagnostic shortcut for QA. The game already has deep systems; the launch risk is players bouncing before they trust movement and aim.
items.recipe: Extend HomeV2's first-run onboarding copy with a calibration step and add a `DEBUG INPUT` control shortcut when diagnostics are enabled.
